name: Travis Scott x Air Jordan Jordan Jumpman Jack TR 'Bright Cactus'
story_html: The Travis Scott x Jordan Jumpman Jack TR 'Bright Cactus' features an upper that combines neon green canvas with off-white tumbled leather overlays. Contrasting black accents land on the reverse lateral-side Swoosh, mid-cut collar and tongue, the latter marked with a tonal Jumpman 'Crown' logo. 'TS' is embroidered on the forefoot strap, while a Cactus Jack smiley graphic adorns the back heel. Underfoot, the durable rubber outsole wraps up the lightweight Phylon midsole.
